subject.title: fix(baseten): reject malformed model metadata numbers

question: Which Baseten numeric-string representations should OpenClaw accept as authoritative live metadata rather than discard in favor of bundled catalog values?
rationale: The upstream public documentation confirms the metadata endpoint but does not define the relevant string grammar, so choosing strict canonical decimal-only parsing versus a narrower safe compatibility grammar is a provider-boundary policy decision.

options.title: Require documented canonical decimal strings
options.body: Keep the strict grammar after recording a Baseten schema or maintainer-approved contract and add representative compatibility tests.

options.title: Preserve safe numeric compatibility
options.body: Allow the existing provider forms that Baseten documents or demonstrably emits while rejecting non-finite, unsafe, and non-positive values.

options.title: Use JSON-number fields only
options.body: Ignore every string-valued numeric field and rely on bundled metadata unless the provider supplies JSON numbers.

recommendation.title: Require documented canonical decimal strings
recommendation.body: Keep the strict grammar after recording a Baseten schema or maintainer-approved contract and add representative compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the current provider-boundary evidence and can update the proposed behavior once the maintainer chooses the intended compatibility contract.
